verdict.rationale: Mercury's Cards API supports 'control card lifecycle states' and spending limits (mercury-docs-36, mercury-docs-52), which could plausibly include locking/freezing a card, and card management is a core feature (mercury-docs-1, mercury-docs-10). However, no evidence explicitly documents a one-click freeze action for a lost/stolen card or an 'order replacement card' workflow. Missing for 10: explicit freeze/lock terminology, replacement-card issuance flow, and any confirmation this works for physical (not just virtual) cards.
